text: Praetorian Argus (Japanese: , Hōō Chokuzoku no Āgasu) is a Unique Monster in . It is an Indoline Star-type Titan, and can be found at level 65 at the 7th Perimeter Skyport in the World Tree. It flies in a circle before settling down by the salvaging point in the middle of the dock. It must be defeated in order to unlock Finch's level 5 Wake-Up Whirl Blade Special and Zenobia's level 5 "Carnage" Battle Skill.

Port Pest Problem (Japanese: , Minato no Shīsu Taiji) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild by talking to Kynon near Central Exchange, when the nation has at least 2 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 50 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 12 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Entomology", "Expeditionist" and "Industry Mastery" Field Skills.

Pookapoo is an NPC in . He is a Nopon who can be found on the Goldmouth Flight Deck in the Argentum Trade Guild during Time is Money. He sells a Titan ship for 300,500 G if the party doesn't borrow a ship from Umon.
The Pretty Seashell is a Key Item in . It can be obtained through Salvaging with a Golden Cylinder on the Goldmouth Flight Deck in the Argentum Trade Guild during the quest Fool's Gold.

Porton Village (Japanese: , Poruta-mura) is a landmark in . It is located in the Lasaria Region, directly beyond Lasaria Woodland. There is a Campsite here, and the Indigo Slate Piece can be found here. This village was the home of Mikhail before it was destroyed by humans during Malos's destruction at the onset of the Aegis War.

The Prayer Rock (Japanese: , Kiganbori no Sekibyō) is a landmark in . It is a small island with a Giants' ruin located on the Bionis' Shoulder, in the middle of the Tranquil Tarn. It must be visited during Tutu's Lost Property, and contains a Unique Monster that jumps out from the water when approached.

Power of Imagination (Japanese: , Sōzō wa Kino wo Sukueru ka, Can imagination save Kino?) is a Quiet Moment in . It is located on the ledge directly above Cragmaw Caverns on the Bionis' Shoulder, reachable by travelling to Abaasy's Dorsum and walking south on the right hand side of the landmark. It is between Kino and Nene, and can be viewed once Teelan's Laboratory has been visited.
Power Goggles L are Mechonis goggles in . They can be purchased from Time Attack for 2,060 Noponstones.
Power II Goggles L are Mechonis goggles in . They can be obtained as rewards after clearing the Uniquely Disadvantaged Time Attack challenge.
Power III Goggles L are Mechonis goggles in . They can be obtained as rewards after clearing the Lost in a Dark Dream Time Attack challenge.
Power Frames L are Mechonis frame in . They can be purchased from Time Attack for 3,300 Noponstones.
Power II Frames L are Mechonis frame in . They can be obtained as rewards after clearing the Uniquely Disadvantaged Time Attack challenge.
Power III Frames L are Mechonis frame in . They can be obtained as rewards after clearing the Lost in a Dark Dream Time Attack challenge.
Power Arms L are Mechonis arms in . They can be purchased from Time Attack for 1,500 Noponstones.
Power II Arms L are Mechonis arms in . They can be obtained as rewards after clearing the Lost in a Dark Dream Time Attack challenge.
Power III Arms L are Mechonis arms in . They can be obtained as rewards after clearing the Lost in a Dark Dream Time Attack challenge.
Praetorian Hill (Japanese: , Puraetaria no Oka) is a Location in . It is located in the City.

The common variant can be purchased from the Colony Iota Commissary, the legendary variant can be obtained from Crystalline DuGarre. They are one of the items that can be used to complete the mission Korresia Finds Her Calling.

|-|Attacker= |-|Defender= |-|Healer= Power Raiser (Japanese: , Pawāreizā) is one of Noah's Arts with Lucky Seven in . The effects of this art change depending on the Role of Noah's current class. This art is unlocked during the battle against the Queen of Agnus. In order to use this art, Noah must first use the Unlimited Sword Talent Art.
|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Power Belts are Accessories in . The legendary variant can be dropped Kilocorn Grandeps or Clinging Azreel.
Power Cores are Sell-Only Collectible items in . They can be found in Origin.
Profound Strength (Japanese: ) is a Battle Art in . It is a variant of Leaping Current that can only be used by Teach. Teach does a staff swinging dance that clears debuffs.
Power Charge is a Status Effect in and . It boosts the damage of the affected character's next damaging Art.
The Prison Terrace (Japanese: , Kangoku no Ma) is a landmark in . It is located at the top of Prison Island, on the sixth floor.

Rabbit Stones (Japanese: , Rabitto Sutōn) are collectables in . They can be found on Valak Mountain and in Colony 6. According to their description, they are red gemstones the colour of a rabbit's eye.

The Pure Perfume is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. Obtaining it is one of two possible routes to complete Looking for Freedom, the other of which involves obtaining Smelly Perfume. It can be found on an island just north of the Great Makna Falls in the Makna Forest.

Quadwings (Japanese: , Kurōdo) are an enemy family in the . They are flying owl-like enemies with four wings (hence the name; quad being Latin for four). Quadwings come in three colour variations, separated by habitat.
Pterix (Japanese: , Puterusu) are an enemy family in the . They are large, flying creatures that resemble pteranodons. Aside from equipment, they all share the same appearance.
Quality Beaks are common materials in . They are dropped by various high-level Flying Enemies on the Bionis. They are not available through trade.
Quality Jets are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by various large flying Mechon, or traded for.

Quality Antol Jaws are rare materials in . They can be dropped by high-level Antols in Colony 9 and traded for with Sylviane and Jackson. According to their description, they are premium-quality insect mandibles in terms of strength and sharpness. Three are needed for A Place to Come Home to.

The Pure Ice Flower is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is the object of The Most Transparent Thing, and must be given to either Berryjammy or Ma'crish. It can be found in Url Crevasse on Valak Mountain.
Quality Plugs are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by various small flying Mechon, or traded for.

Pugiliths (ベルデロ, Berudero) are a type of robotic machine used by the Ganglion in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are ostrich-like mobile cannons, operated by a Puge sitting where the bird's head would be. The Puge pilot can be targetted and destroyed, though this will not stop the Pugilith as it can continue to attack without a pilot.

Prone Destroyers (Japanese: , Baiasu Purasutā) are three story exclusive enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone and are fought at level 15 at Sunlit Spring in Noctilum. The party fights them upon reaching Sunlit Spring, and the cutscenes after the battle lead directly to the boss battle with Goetia.
Quos (Japanese: , Kuō) are a type of Ganglion's machines in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are flying drones.

Radovan, the Sky Baron (, Arawashi no Radovan) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Jacul family. It can be found at level 37 flying above an arch over Lake Ciel in Sylvalum during the day.

The Qlurians or Qlu (Japanese: , Kuryū; English dub: for Qlurian, for Qlu) are a race of beings in . They are a alien race with a very advanced technology. Celica, first met in Noctilum during Manhunt, is a Qlurian who becomes a member of the BLADE. Neilnail is a Qlurian who is known as the High Custodian. Qlurian technology borrows heavily from the ancient Samaarians. This led to the Qlurian worshipping them, and after a few thousand years, the Qlurian reached unparalleled levels of prosperity. Qlurian ancestors sought to spread their faith across the galaxy, preaching to other races and sharing their technology. They even reached Mira, having influenced the ancient civilization that lived

Purgovents (Japanese: , Morumu) are Piscinoid enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They look like huge flying fish-like creatures, with many similarities to Lophids. They can be found in Noctilum, Oblivia, and Sylvalum.
Prone Vix Hawks (Japanese: , Baiasu Muru Hōku) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 33-37 on the large island in Primordia Waters.

Quality Giant Cells are unique materials in . They can be obtained from Sylooth, for 114 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks, or for 90 Material Tickets from the Material Market in . They are one of the components of Weapon Attack Power Up and Custom.WP-ATK X, XV and XX augments.

Radius Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Meredith & Co. Raygun. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Shotgun Diplomacy, alongside the Haven II Series. The Radius weapons available in-game are: * Storm Radius * Soldier Radius * Warrior Radius * Delta Radius * Destroyer Radius * Ophidian Radius * Striker Radius * Cosmic Radius * Nebulan Radius * Ultra Nebulan Radius

Radius II Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Meredith & Co. Raygun. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Forbidden Love. The Radius II weapons available in-game are: * Storm Radius II * Soldier Radius II * Warrior Radius II * Ophidian Radius II * Destroyer Radius II * Striker Radius II * Delta Radius II * Cosmic Radius II * Nebulan Radius II * Ultra Nebulan Radius II

Psylans Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts Grenada Galactic Group Psycho Launchers. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Wreckage category of the Noctilum Collectopedia. The Psylans weapons available in-game are: * Storm Psylans * Soldier Psylans * Warrior Psylans * Ophidian Psylans * Delta Psylans * Striker Psylans * Destroyer Psylans * Cosmic Psylans * Nebulan Psylans
R-Cannons are back weapons for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from MG068: Megisia or by destroying Seidrs' weapon appendages.

Pyra (Japanese: , Homura; English dub: ) is one of the female protagonists in . She is the Aegis, a Legendary Blade who can grant tremendous fire-elemental power to her Driver, Rex. Pyra and Rex embark on a journey to search for Elysium, and Rex is devoted to protecting her. Due to sharing her life force with Rex, Pyra is not able to recover from injuries like other Blades, and is as vulnerable to damage as any other human. If either of the two were to die, the other would follow. Pyra was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer for the game.

Puri Leaf Cabbages are Vegetable collectibles in . They can be found in the Argentum Trade Guild, in particular from a Collection Point on the Goldmouth Flight Deck. In the , Puri Leaf Cabbages can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.

Protect the Holy Place (Japanese: , Shinseina Basho wo Mamore) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Gormott Province by talking to Wold in the Grodd Residential Zone, when the nation has at least 3 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 80 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 20 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Ancient Wisdom", "Lockpicking" and "Expeditionist" Field Skills.

Raddon Family is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Gormott Province, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 2 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 50 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 12 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Expeditionist" and "Keen Eye" Field Skills. It rewards store contracts that unlock the following wares: * Mince & Lentil Stir-Fry in Gryff Butchers * Passion Fruit Shake in Café Savvy * Woodboard in Soniarus Music

Quantum Technochampion π is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located on Lv. 2, Mizar: Lower Deck in the World Tree. It features a conversation between Poppi QTπ, Tora, and Zeke. It also shows additional hidden features of Poppi QTπ, such as a dog mode and self-destruct mechanism. Viewing this Heart-to-Heart is required to unlock Poppi QTπ's level 4 "Overclock" Battle Skill. In New Game Plus, Powered-Up Poppi must be completed before it can be viewed. __TOC__
Radna Arachnos are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Arachno family, and can be found at level 45 on the Black Mountains.

Quick Cooldown is a battle mechanic in . Quick Cooldown allows the player to use an art that is still in cooldown. Quick Cooldown is activated by pressing , provided the party has enough aux energy. Collecting Energy Clips will increase the party's maximum reserve of aux energy usable for Quick Cooldowns. Aux energy will recharge after a battle ends. After completing Chapter 13 (Act 3), the ability to use Quick Cooldown while piloting a Skell is unlocked. Using Quick Cooldown for Skell Arts consumes twice as much aux energy as normal arts.

no11=RE:ARR.X is a track in Xenoblade Chronicles X, composed and arranged by Hiroyuki Sawano. It is track 11 of disc one from the XenobladeX Original Soundtrack, and the eleventh part of the suite titled 0rCH-SUITE "X". This music is heard in the ending of the main storyline, when the party restores the Lifehold Core power, contacts Nagi, and returns to New Los Angeles.
Regenerate is a Buff in . It causes a character to recover a certain amount of HP every few seconds. The amount of HP restored and the duration of the effect depends on the source.

Reef Nebulae are enemies in . They are members of the Nebula family, and can be found at level 43 in many places at Valak Mountain. They drop Snow Elements, two of which are needed for Colony 6 Reconstruction.
Randa Nebulae (Japanese: , Randa Nebura) are enemies in . They are members of the Nebula family, and can be found at level 74 on Prison Island around the Bridge of Grief.

The Regeneration Control (Japanese: , Feisu Saisei-sō Seigyoshitsu) is a landmark in . It is located on the third floor of the Central Factory, within the Face Maintenance Bay. There are three workstations that give the appearance of switches, but these are just red herrings, as there is never any actual switch here.

Rapture Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Factory 1.21 Assault Rifle . It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Professorial, along with the Honor, Faith and Multi Series. The Rapture weapons available in-game are: * Storm Rapture * Soldier Rapture * Warrior Rapture * Ophidian Rapture * Destroyer Rapture * Striker Rapture * Delta Rapture * Cosmic Rapture * Nebulan Rapture

Raygun Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Sakuraba Industries Raygun. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Fruits category of the Oblivia Collectopedia. The Raygun weapons available in-game are: * Combat Raygun * Storm Raygun * Soldier Raygun * Warrior Raygun * Ophidian Raygun * Destroyer Raygun * Striker Raygun * Delta Raygun * Cosmic Raygun * Nebulan Raygun

Ratatatta Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Nopon Commerce Guild Gatling Gun. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Unsatisfied Customer. The Ratatatta weapons available in-game are: * Storm Ratatatta * Soldier Ratatatta * Warrior Ratatatta * Ophidian Ratatatta * Destroyer Ratatatta * Striker Ratatatta * Delta Ratatatta * Original Ratatatta * Cosmic Ratatatta * Nebulan Ratatatta

Ravenwing Skull (Japanese: , Kokuyoku no Sukaru) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Ageshu family and can be found at level 62 at the Xataris Spring in Temperantia. It flies in when the player steps onto the island in the middle of the spring. It must be defeated in order to unlock Gorg's level 5 Bittersweet Dreams and Obrona’s level 5 Cruel World Specials, and Zenobia's level 5 "Wind Mastery" Field Skill.

The Red Room (Japanese: , Reddorūmu) is a Location in . It is located in the Fonsett Waters of the Leftherian Archipelago. It is a secret room hidden underneath Island Base Lindwurm which is used by Don Dondon and Zadazan.
Ranger Ignas (Japanese: , Renjā Igūna) are enemies in . They are members of the Igna family, and can be found at level 31-33 at the Old City of Teddim in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Rainbow Scopes are Art Pouch items in . They can be made by Dahlia using her "Icecraft Lv.2" field skill at the Dahlia's Icecraft table in Argentum's Goldmouth Warehouse, after completion of her Blade Quest Fly in the Ointment.

Rare Goods Repairs is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Uraya, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 4 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 2 hours, but it can be reduced down to 30 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Lockpicking", "Mastery of Thunder" and "Industry Mastery" Field Skills.

Rainbow Shell is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Uraya by talking to Vasq in a wooden balcony east of Maluria Antiques, when the nation has at least 3 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 100 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 25 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Water Mastery", "Production Mastery" and "Ice Mastery" Field Skills. After completing the mission, talking to Vasq after Indol sinks in Chapter 9 provides Vasq's Recipe, allowing Pyra to make Roast Meat Tagliata through cooking.

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Reflect Immunity (Japanese: , Hansha Mukō) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in and . It annuls enemy reflection abilities such as Gladiator Orion's "True Bared Counter" and Artifice Ophion's "Barrier Field", preventing damage from being reflected back to the party. Some lower rarity variants that can be obtained in the Challenge Battle Mode have a small chance to not trigger. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__

Rebel Purge (Japanese: , Hanran Bunshi no Shukusei) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Gormott Province by talking to Monich at the Torigoth Relay Base, when the nation has at least 5 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 2 hours, but it can be reduced down to 30 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Dark Mastery" and "Assassination" Field Skills.

Reclamation is a DLC Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Leftherian Archipelago automatically after clearing the DLC Quest Cleared of All Charges. The time required to complete this mission is 30 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 7 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Agronomy" and "Superstrength" Field Skills. It uniquely awards more Trust Points than other normal Merc Missions. Completing it will unlock the DLC Merc Mission Seeding.

Rebellion Cave (Japanese: , Riberion Keivu) is a location in . It is located within the Malevolent Hollow in Erythia Sea. The party's Ouroboros powers are restricted here, which prevents Interlinking.

Redeeming Bloom is a Battle Art in . It is one of Nia's arts as a Hero, which is a variant of Waterlily. When used, it creates a field that heals allies standing within at a rate of 75% of the user's Healing Power every three seconds.
Red Schorl is a DLC Key Item in . It can be obtained on Corne Island during the Quest For the Sake of Keepsakes. Masha uses it to make the Contract Bracelets for Jake and Tessa.
Raxeal Lavaflow (Japanese: , Rekushīru Yōgandō) is a Landmark in , located on the Black Mountains. The Unique Monster Dragon God Alcar can be found here. __TOC__

The Ravaged Village (Japanese: , Horonda Mura) is a location in , located on the Aurora Shelf. It can be accessed from the Lakeside Grotto via an Ether Lift and two Ether Slides. It is what remains of the village intended to be made into a second City after it was burned down by Kevesi soldiers. There is an Affinity Scene and a Fog Rift found here. An Ether Mast and an Ether Slide that leads to the Palace of Bal Attas can be constructed here.
Ranged Tirkins are Normal Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family, and can be found at level 42 on the Black Mountains.
Ranged Power Up is a buff in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases ranged attack damage.
Ranged Power Down is a debuff in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It reduces ranged attack damage.

Rius Antols (Japanese: , Riusu Antoru) are enemies in . They are members of the Antol family, and can be found at level 52 at the Transformer Area, 5th Pulse Zone, as well as Digit 1, in Fallen Arm. They can drop the Silver Antol Fibres needed for Power Up!.

The Regulation Piston (Japanese: , Kussaku Chōsei Pisuton Mae) is a landmark in . It is located on the first basement floor of the Ether Mine. An Ether Crystal deposit containing Attack Stability II and Bleed Defence II crystals can be found here.

Regret (悔恨) is an Event Track in and , composed and arranged by Manami Kiyota. It is track 15 of disc 1 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack, and track nine of disc four from the Xenoblade Definitive Edition Original Soundtrack and the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This music is a sad theme that is heard in the following cutscenes: * Sharla's tragic tale to Shulk and Reyn about the fate of Colony 6 * Sharla's flashback dream to Gadolt's parting * Otharon's falling out with the party in the Ether Mine after Shulk's reluctance * Melia reports to Sorean the events in Makna Forest and is named crown princess * Face Nemesis meets the party at the Great Glacier on Valak Mountain * A

Repethe Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Grenada Galactic Group Gatling Gun. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Fauna category of the Sylvalum Collectopedia. The Repethe weapons available in-game are: * Storm Repethe * Soldier Repethe * Warrior Repethe * Ophidian Repethe * Destroyer Repethe * Striker Repethe * Delta Repethe * Cosmic Repethe * Nebulan Repethe

Retic Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Grenada Galactic Group Sniper Rifle. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Flora category of the Oblivia Collectopedia. The Retic weapons available in-game are: * Storm Retic * Soldier Retic * Warrior Retic * Ophidian Retic * Destroyer Retic * Striker Retic * Delta Retic * Cosmic Retic * Nebulan Retic

Resource Seizure is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.9, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of collecting eight Bullet Flys. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Rex's Secret Base (Japanese: , Rekkusu no Himitsukichi) is a Location in . It is located on Fonsett Island in the Leftherian Archipelago. It is a small base which was used by Rex when he was a child. It is hidden and blocked by some ivy which requires level 5 "Fire Mastery" and level 3 "Wind Mastery" Field Skills to remove. The Heart-to-Heart "Little Rex" is located here.

Revival Pods are accessories in . They prevent the wearer from falling in battle from an attack that would result in their Incapacitation, allowing them to survive with 1 HP and granting them 5 seconds of invincibility to recover from the devastating blow. This effect can only trigger once per battle.

Renowned Goods is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Gormott Province, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 3 stars in Development Level. It will only become available after visiting the Leftherian Archipelago for the first time. The time required to complete this mission is 1 hour, but it can be reduced down to 15 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Transport Mastery" and "Production Mastery" Field Skills. It rewards store contracts that unlock the following wares: * Conch Hairpin in Cosmetipolitan * Leaf-Weave Cape in Neuromin Textiles

Road Repairs is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Uraya, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 3 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 100 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 25 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Mineralogy", "Industry Mastery" and "Wind Mastery" Field Skills.

Rhiannon is an NPC in . She is a Gormotti who is first found on Melnath's Shoulder in Gormott Province alongside her lover Norman, and approaching them automatically triggers Star-Crossed Lovers. Depending on how the party finishes the aforementioned quest, she and Norman will relocate to either the Grodd Residential Zone in Torigoth or the Empire of Mor Ardain. She is Carys and Wyn's daughter and Nils's sister.

Rex's Condition is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Leftherian Archipelago, and is unlocked automatically when Garfont Mercenaries reaches Merc Level 3 and the nation reaches 3 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 80 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 20 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Info Collector", "Expeditionist" and "Girls' Talk" Field Skills.

Research Results is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Indoline Praetorium by talking to Halaric near the Milama Viewpoint, when the nation has at least 4 stars in Development Level. After Chapter 8, it can also be received automatically from the Leftherian Archipelago; if the mission was already unlocked in Indol before that point, it will be transferred to Leftheria. The time required to complete this mission is 80 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 20 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Ichthyology", "Electric Mastery" and "Transport Mastery" Field Skills. XP values shown for Merc Level 1. Reward is increased for higher Merc Ranks.

Rising Crescent (Japanese: , Kuresentoraijingu, Lit. "Crescent Rising") is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using a Calamity Scythe. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Rex's Power Swipe.

Regodos Totem (Japanese: , Regodosu Pōru) is a Challenge Battle Enemy in . It is a Totem, and can be found at level 100 during the Challenge Battle, Sacred Wood. This enemy drops no items, and has the ability to summon Highbow Tirkins, Highpipe Tirkins, Highshield Tirkins and Highspear Tirkins.

Regus Moramoras are minor enemies in . They are members of the Moramora family and can be found at level 27 - 34 flying above the Ancient Lakebed in the Aletta Region and Peln, Pilgrim's Springland in the Dannagh Region of the Kingdom of Torna. Two need to be defeated to unlock Jin's level 4 Zero Blade.

The Remembrance Stones (Japanese: , Meikokuhi) are a Landmark in , located near the Caelum Residential Quarter in the City. They serve as a memorial for Citizens who have passed away, due to their bodies dissolving into light upon death rather then leaving husks.
Ribelly Plaza (Japanese: , Rīberi Hiroba) is a Location in . It is located in the City. It can be accessed from the Training Ground.
The Relay Base Bridge (Japanese: , Chūkei Kichi: Renrakubashi) is a Landmark in . It is located on Thurbin Island in Erythia Sea. It leads into the Erythia Relay Base.

Ring Guavas are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Cadensia Region. They can also be purchased from the City Caravan, or produced from the Atoll Ferronis Hulk Fabricator or the Sandbar Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.

Riku's Workshop (Japanese: , Riku no Kōbō) is a Landmark in , located by the Main Entrance of Colony 9 in Yesterdale. It is the rundown remains of Dunban and Fiora's house, and is where Riku sets up his workshop where the party can upgrade their weapons after completing Riku's Workshop. There are two Affinity Scenes found here: one found in Dunban's bedroom, and another outside the house that is viewable starting in Chapter 4. There is also a Relic located in Fiora's bedroom. After reaching Prison Island, the party can examine Lucky Seven in the workshop as well as talk to Riku.

Riot is an Aura used by Fogbeasts in . Upon being encountered, Fogbeasts will spread a riot surge in a set radius around themselves, drawing in nearby monsters. Enemies under the effects of the surge will become aggressive toward the party. These enemies will also be affected by the Riot Aura, which will increase their level based on the strength of the Fogbeast. This aura can be removed in the same ways as any other auras, like using Shulk's Monado Purge or Melia's Mind Blast, as well as by inflicting Daze. Doing so will remove the Riot Aura's level-up effect. Story Exclusive Fogbeasts will not spread a riot surge.

Ruby Mangosteens (Japanese: , Rubī Mangosuchin) are collectables in . They can be found on Valak Mountain. According to their description, they are fruits that sparkle like a jewel and they outshine other fruits in tanginess. Two are required for World's Strongest Flavour.

The Sacred Altar (Japanese: , Goshintai no Saidan) is a landmark in . It is located in the Central Plaza of Frontier Village, being the central landmark. It is in the large tree, and in the center of this area there is a pool with a bridge to a little island in the middle. The sacred object is housed here, which protects Frontier Village from monsters, Mechon, and Telethia alike. It is here that the party meets Riki. Surrounding this pool is an area where Nopon are found at all times of day and quests are given. There are also some shops, but only one sells the party anything.

The Rotating Bulkhead (Japanese: , Kaiten-shiki Bōheki) is a landmark in . It is located on the upper level of the Fallen Arm where the party goes on their way to Mechonis. It is a large machine with green and red lights on it. The party needs a key to move the internal part, which they receive from Linada. This enables the party to proceed to Mechonis. If the path is followed, it leads to a massive road that stretches across the endless sea towards Mechonis' foot. From this point there is a good view of Bionis and Mechonis. This road is destroyed after the events of the Mechonis Core and the death of Mechonis.

Sacred Zagamei (Japanese: , Reihō no Zagamei) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Tude family, and can be found at level 89 on the island below Hovering Reef 9 in the Eryth Sea, which can be reached by dropping through the hole in the middle of the reef.

The Safety Device Key is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be found as a red collectable in Galahad Fortress, near the Blast Furnace Conduit (although it is behind bars alongside a Fire Ether Gear, and can only be reached from the Ether Input Stream). It can be used to activate the Self-Destruct Device found near the Piston Control Room, which destroys the windows of the 1st and 2nd Turbine Rooms.
The Ruined City of O'rrh Sim (Japanese: , O-Ra-Shīmu Shigai-ato) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Cauldros one hex southeast of FN Site 505. A lava river lies to the east.

Rogebra Shockstones (Japanese: , Rōgebura no Hōdenseki) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros, specifically in the water off the west coast near a small island. Nine of them are needed for A New Spark.

Rocket Jaculs (Japanese: , Bāsuto Hasutara, Burst Jacul) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Jacul family, and can be found at level 35-36 along the Forgotten Mining Frigate pathways near FN Site 509 in Cauldros. They can also be found at level 31-40 on the unnamed island in Cauldros Waters west-southwest of Far Isle of Tzu'o.

Sacrum, the Noctilucent (Japanese: , Yakō no Seikurido) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Papil family. It can be found at level 50 in Noctilum, within Whale's Weeper, during the night and late night. Olegario, the Iron-Helmed and Seti, the Light of Stars are located in the same spot at the same time.

Sacrifoles (Japanese: , Kurusuta) are flying flower-like Insectoid enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are similar to Mortifoles, but with crystals on top of their body and feathers patterned with vein-like designs. They can be found in Sylvalum and Cauldros.

Rubidium Fal-swos (Japanese: , Rubiji Gi-suo) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Fal-swo machines, and can be found at level 41 near South Hardheart Canyon in Sylvalum. A squadron of six level 50 Rubidium Fal-swos flies high above Seabird's Beak from Primordia Waters; this event is triggered by flying high into the air.

Sad Bernard (Japanese: , Kokō no Bābari) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Feris family and can be found at level 12 on Garanti Plain in the Gormott Province. It must be defeated in order to unlock Zenobia's Level 2 "Superstrength" Affinity Reward.
Saets Lumber Co. (Japanese: , Shubia Mokuzaijo) is a Location in . It is located in the Gormott Province, just outside the city walls and main entrance of Torigoth.

Rogue Miners is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Uraya by talking to Smaghi, who stands by Eslan on the pathway to Garfont's Training Ground, when the nation has at least 2 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 50 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 12 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Water Mastery", "Dark Mastery" and "Fortitude" Field Skills.
Saber Ignas (Japanese: , Seibā Igūna) are enemies in . They are members of the Igna family, and can be found at level 28-33 at the Old City of Teddim in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Rododo is an NPC in . He can be found on the Goldmouth Flight Deck in the Argentum Trade Guild. Rododo is shown to have a great knowledge and interest in history, primarily regarding the Argentum Trade Guild but also in other subjects, such as the Kingdom of Uraya.
Rozana is an NPC in . She is Gray's wife and can be found in the City.
Runaeda Torpedo Wraps is a shop in . It is run by the Torpedo Wrapsmith at Centrilo Parade in the City, but only during the quest Unsolved Riddle.
Ronja is an NPC and in who can be found in Colony 15, and later in the City.
Romero (Japanese: , Romero) is an NPC in who can be found in the City.

Ruben is an NPC in . He is a City Survivor who moves to Colony 9's Central Plaza in Yesterdale after being rescued from the Inconspicuous Cave in Vermilion Woods. Ruben's Community can be gained after talking to him twice and completing Step by Step.

Satorl Tortas are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Torta family, and can be found at level 85 near the Altar of Fate in Satorl Marsh. They can drop Immortal Moss, one of which is required to complete the quest Replica Monado 2.

Satorl Caterpiles (Japanese: , Zatōru Kyapiru) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Caterpile family, and can be found at level 25-27 at the Place of Judgement and east of the Exile Fortress in Satorl Marsh. They are the only enemies that drop Caterpile Vinegar, which is needed for Unstoppable Berryjammy.

Seahorse Islet (Japanese: , Tatsunōtoshigo) is a Secret Area in . It is located in Makna Forest. It is a tiny little island found at the very north end of the river running from Great Makna Falls which runs beneath the four bridges, right before the waterfall that just falls to nowhere. The Proof of Courage must be collected from here for Challenge of the Sage.

The Sealed Tower (Japanese: , Fūin no Tō), formerly known as Ose Tower (English dub: ), is a location in . It is located on the lower level of Valak Mountain, near the Harict Chapel landmark. It is of High Entia origin.

Sanjibal Behemoths (Japanese: , Sanjibaru Behimosu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Behemoth family, and can be found at level 78 in the Behemoth Nest of Prison Island. The Behemoth Nest can be reentered from the Arena when the Bone Pillar is lowered, or from the Kitchen by climbing up the chimney-like passage that was opened by the Meal Lift Activator. The latter requires the Kitchen Door Key, which can be found in the hallway south of the Arena, and is used to open the door on the southern wall between Banquet Hall and the Kitchen.

Saldox Nebulae (Japanese: , Sarudokusu Nebura) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Nebula family, and can be found at level 40 during the first visit to Prison Island, along the paths southwest of the High Entia Transporter and through the Great Canyon.
Salt-Roasted Birds are common materials in . They can be dropped by Vangs, Ansels, and Taos on Valak Mountain, or by trading with Zain.

Sakuraba Industries (Japanese: , Sakuraba Jūkō, English dub: ) is a product Arms Manufacturer in Xenoblade Chronicles X. This enterprise forms the heart of the Sakuraba Group, and is respected for the quality of their workmanship. Its CEO is Dan Sakuraba. It is one of the two initial Arms Manufacturers in New Los Angeles, along with the Grenada Galactic Group. Their weapons are known for stability, but they lag behind in resistance against attributes other than physical.

Sandsprint Cavity (Japanese: , Sunahashiri no Yokoana) is an Unexplored Territory in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a cave located in Sylvalum, south-southeast of FN Site 406 in the passageway between Lake Ciel and Badr Basin, and can be reached in a Skell by flying to a ledge in the passageway opening in the rock wall. As with all Unexplored Territories, its discovery yields an achievement ("Sprinting to Sandsprint Cavity").

Seaswept Rise (Japanese: , Fūha no Oka) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia, an elevated area in the southeastern part of the continent. The Seaswept Base is located in the nearby hills, and the rise must be visited during A Dubious Operation.

Scintimures (Japanese: , Torizumo) are flying Piscinoid creatures in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are large electrical eel-like fishes, similar to Duoguills. They can be found in Noctilum, Sylvalum, and Cauldros.

The Seabird's Beak BC (Japanese: , Umidori no Kuchibashi BC) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located on the Seabird's Beak beach in Sylvalum, and is the first base camp visited on that continent.

Sand Aeviters (Japanese: , Sando Tidāra) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Aeviter family, and can be found hidden at level 41-50 in Hilal Meadow and North Silent Sandsea in Sylvalum. Four of them must be defeated for Aeviter Ace. They can drop the Aeviter Star Wings needed for The Nopon Heir.

Sclopetum Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Meredith & Co. Assault Rifle. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Frontier Spirit, alongside the Grando Series. The Sealed Quarry (Japanese: , Tozasareta Kōsekijō) is a location in . It is located on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal. It can be reached by Skip Traveling to Airborne Throne, sliding and jumping off the frozen path. It has two levels, the upper reachable via level 7 Wind Mastery and level 5 Leaping field skills. The Flutterheart Grass required for Making Love Source can be found here, as can Humhum and Mylak during Partners. There are no enemies here, although during misty weather nearby flying enemies may be lured.

Screw Coils are Mechanical collectibles in . They can be found on the World Tree, in particular by Salvaging with any cylinders at the 7th Perimeter Skyport. They can be used to fill the charging device during the quest Powered-Up Poppi. Each Screw Coil will fill the gauge by 2 points.

Salvaging Security (Japanese: , Sarubēji-chū no Anzen Kakuho) is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Argentum Trade Guild by talking to Tiwitiwi on the Salvage Deck, when the nation has at least 1 star in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 30 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 7 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Expeditionist", "Water Mastery" and "Salvaging Mastery" Field Skills.
School is in Session is a quest in . It can be received from Willas on Fonsett Island in the Leftherian Archipelago. After finishing this quest the location Azure Schoolhouse will be discovered.
Science Teacher is a quest in . It can be received from Willas on Fonsett Island in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Secret Route is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Uraya, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 4 star in Development Level. It will only become available after visiting the Kingdom of Tantal for the first time. The time required to complete this mission is 100 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 25 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Expeditionist", "Nopon Wisdom" and "Transport Mastery" Field Skills. It rewards store contracts that unlock the following wares: * Hearty Kordeth Puran in Brad Flatforms * Pickled Ice Cabbage in Sadecott Groceries * Whitebait With Seeds in Ikthus Fishmongers * Addam's Love and War in Aldomar Books

Secret Spice is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Empire of Mor Ardain, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 1 star in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 40 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 10 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Production Mastery", "Harmony" and "Expeditionist" Field Skills. It rewards store contracts that unlock the following wares: * Crispy Vegetable Salad in Griogair's Greens * Tube Xylophone in Adelno Music * Felmeri Fairy Statue in Yafush Antiques

It can be received in the Empire of Mor Ardain by talking to Millod near Hardhaigh Dock, Lv. 2, when the nation has at least 4 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 100 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 25 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Entomology", "Forestry" and "Earth Mastery" Field Skills.

Sailor Merignas are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Merigna family, and can be found at level 47-48 at Anu Shoals in Erythia Sea. They ride on Merfreys. One is also fought at level 54 during the fourth wave of the Challenge Battle Ocean Day Parade.

Searle is an NPC in . She is a City Survivor that can be found in Colony 9 in Yesterdale after being rescued from the Sullied Temple of Abitalia on the Aurora Shelf. Her Community is gained by talking to her after conversing with her three times and changing the Community Status of Babalulu, Guguru, and Bobobi.
Sakuraba Flight Jacket is a Holofigure in . It depicts a male mannequin wearing Al's Bodywear. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Affinity Mission A Hero's Trial.

Shimmering Forte (Japanese: , Kagerō no Forute) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Deinos family, and can be found at level 33 east of the Eks Watering Hole in Makna Forest during Torrid weather. A hot day is signified by a shimmering haze on screen and the absence of birdsong sounds. The party must defeat the Shimmering Forte to complete Makna Forest's Challenge quest given by a Nopon Merchant. Additionally, it can drop a Magic Stone, two of which are needed for Material Quest 1. If the party stands in the path just south of the heart-to-heart, facing north-west, Shimmering Forte will appear on the path in front of them when the weather is right. Señorita Scarabs (Japanese: , Senyorīta Kabuto) are collectables in . They can be found in Prison Island. According to their description, they are stocky beetles that have a graceful ladylike demeanour.

Serene Imlaly (Japanese: , Meikyō no Imurari) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Deinos family, and can be found at level 76 in the Banquet Hall on Prison Island, running around the central opening and followed by one Babel Deinos. It inflicts counter spike damage that can be decreased or cancelled using Spike Defence gems or Monado Purge.

Setor Eks are enemies in . They are members of the Eks family, and can be found during the day at level 96 on Bionis' Right Elbow or on the trail that leads down from Zokhed Pass on Valak Mountain. A herd of 2 Setor Elks together are found at level 94. These Eks can drop the elusive Ledios Cuisses.

Sestago Lexos are enemies in . They are members of the Lexos family, and can be found at level 47 near Bagnar Snowfield on Valak Mountain at night. They can drop the Silver Lexos Hearts needed for I Want to be a Homs!.

The Shrine Transporter (Japanese: , Shinden Tensō Sōchi) is a landmark in . It is found in the city of Agniratha. It is here that the party is confronted by Gadolt in his Faced Mechon, and where he is fought twice. After he is defeated, the party continues on the Meyneth Cloister, where they fight Egil. Gadolt stays behind at the transporter. The party passes back through the Tranporter again later when Agniratha starts to explode, however Gadolt has disappeared. He reappears soon after and sacrifices himself in order to save the party from the explosion.

Serik Waterfall (Japanese: , Serikku taki) is a location in . It is a large frozen waterfall, located on the upper level of Valak Mountain above the Apis Lair. There are no enemies near it, and it must be passed to reach Three Sage Summit. A Water Ether Crystal deposit can be found here. To reach the waterfall, skip travel to Zokhed Pass and take the second path to the right. It cannot be reached from the Apis Lair.

The Self-Destruct Device is a button in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is located on the first basement floor of Galahad Fortress just north of the Piston Control Room, and requires the Safety Device Key to be operated. Once the key is obtained, the button can be pressed, which destroys the two turbine rooms' windows and contents. The rooms can then be entered through the broken windows via the yellow pipes. The 1st Turbine Room will contain three guaranteed Ultramarine Ant spawn points, and the 2nd Turbine Room will contain three guaranteed Art Core Coil spawn points; two of the latter are needed for the reconstruction of Colony 6.

Selenium Oc-servs (Japanese: , Seren Me-Tsuu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Oc-serv machines, and can be found at level 33-34 in Cauldros on the elevated walkway above FN Site 504, and next to the building at the Ruined City of O'rrh Sim.

Shinhwa, the Sagacious (Japanese: , Sōmeina Shinfa) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Terebra and can be found at level 24 in Decapotamon in Noctilum, on a small island north of Skybound Coil Tree. Defeating it is required to complete the eponymous Basic Mission Shinhwa, the Sagacious.
Shooting Star is one of many Ranged Arts in . It is learned at Class Rank 8 by the Blast Fencer and used while wielding Psycho Launchers.

Seti, the Light of Stars (Japanese: , Seikō no Seti) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Cervus family. It can be found at level 50 in Noctilum, within Whale's Weeper, at night. Olegario, the Iron-Helmed and Sacrum, the Noctilucent are located in the same spot at the same time.
Shrad B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a silvery shrad variant. It can be obtained from silver drops from the Experimental Flight Shrad in Cauldros.
Sharp Ears are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are dropped by enemies in Prison Island.
Serpronds (Japanese: , Rodon) are a family of enemies in the . They are flying aquatic enemies very similar to Marrins.

Seveeto Laias (Japanese: , Suvēto Raia) are enemies in . They are members of the Laia family, and can be found at level 44-46 at the Canyon of Husks on the Upper Level of the Spirit Crucible Elpys. Four of them must be defeated to unlock Dahlia's level 3 "Ice Mastery" and Agate's Level 4 Star Beryl Courage.

Serious Showdown is a Challenge Battle in . It can be received from the Nopon Archsage in the Land of Challenge, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. This challenge must be completed in order to unlock Fiora's level 5 Power Smash Blade Special and Elma's level 4 "Background Noise" Battle Skill. This challenge takes place at the Gotrock Oracle Ruins on the Cliffs of Morytha.

They boost the wearer's resistance to Party Gauge draining attacks by up to 100%, allowing for full immunity to effects that deplete the gauge, such as Rage Strikes. They are the upgraded version of the Ocean Earring accessory. They can be found in the Land of Challenge from Treasure Troves obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass.

Shackle Driver is a status effect in and . It is a party debuff that temporarily seals the abilities of a Driver. When the debuff activates, the Driver becomes bound by fluorescent red chains. It lasts for 6 seconds. During its duration the Driver cannot use any Arts, trigger Blade Specials or switch out their Blades. Additionally, they become unable to revive incapacitated party members. However, their Blades can still perform Blade Arts. In , Drivers affected by the status can still swap positions using Vanguard Switch and trigger their Switch Arts. Since the effect doesn't affect the Affinity Bond, their Blades can still use their own Specials and Arts without restriction.
Serene Square (Japanese: , Ikoi no Kohiroba) is a Landmark in . It is located in the City.

The Shattered Pathway (Japanese: , Hōrakushita Tsūro) is a Landmark in . It is located in the The Cavity of Swordmarch. It is the only named place within The Cavity.

Seraphic Ceratinia (Japanese: , Shiten Shinjū Seratinia; Ceratinia, Divine Beast of the Burning Skies) is one of the Superbosses in . It is a Unique Monster, but not a member of any particular family, and can be found at level 120 in the The Cavity of Swordmarch. It is the highest level enemy in the game and requires beating Kilocorn Grandeps, Perilwing Ryuho, Dreadwyrm Nizoont, Levialord Empireo, and gathering an info fragment in the City talking about it for the Discussion "Aionios' Strongest" to appear at a Rest Spot. Segaro Camills are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Camill family, and can be found at level 40-42 at the Great Sword's Base and the Perimeter Woodland of Li Garte Prison Camp, and level 45 on Corne Island in Erythia Sea.
Shiner is an NPC in who can be found in the City. He is a member of House Ortiz, Playne's son and Timna's grandson.

Sentries are enemies in . They are automated defense systems of the World Tree. They are poles with digital halos, giving them the appearance of miniature versions of the World Tree. They have no offensive capabilities but draw the attention of nearby Sovereigns. They are somewhat similar to Totems or Standards but apply for Sovereigns.

Shura (Japanese: , Shūra) is a Homs in . She can be found briefly in the Bafalgar Tomb in Tephra Cave, and is a source of rare Critical Up V gems. Otherwise, she can be found in the southern portion of the Commercial District in Colony 9.

Silver Antol Fibres (Japanese: , Antoru no Shiroganeito) are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from Aura and Rius Antols on the Fallen Arm. They can also be traded for with Shilx and Rakzet, the former only when on the Fallen Arm. According to their description, they are threads that flash like lightning and they are often used for decorating clothes. Eight of them are needed to complete Level 4 Commerce in Colony 6, and five are required for Power Up!. In Definitive Edition, they can be purchased in Time Attack place from Nopon Archsage for 2,900 Noponstones.

The Sky Terrace (Japanese: , Tenkū no Terasu) is a location in . It is located on the second floor of Alcamoth, west of the Audience Chamber, just behind the teleporter. It is a circular balcony area, with a spectacular view of the whole of Alcamoth and most of Eryth Sea. Telethia Kaelin can be found here during A Release From Duty. There is also a Heart-to-Heart located here, "A Breathtaking Sight", between Reyn and Melia at pink affinity.
Skeeters (Japanese: , Sukīto) are flying, mosquito-like enemies in the . They are of a similar size to Fliers and Wisps, and sometimes denoted Skeets.

The Sky Stage (Japanese: , Tenkū no Butai) is a location in . It is located on the lower level of Bionis' Leg, north of Viliera Hill. Many flying enemies can be found here. The Sky Frying Pan is found here during Cook-Off Final Blow?!.

Sky Rods (Japanese: , Sukairoddo) are weapons in . They are staffs usable by Melia. They can be acquired by purchasing them at Colony 6 Shop 5 as well at Zokhed Pass Shop in Valak Mountain for 18,240 G.

The Silver Wreckage (Japanese: , Hakugin no Zangai) is a location in . It is at the Wreckage Beach on the Fallen Arm, right on the shoreline. As the name suggests, it is the remains of the silver Faced Mechon, Fiora's Face Nemesis, who was destroyed on impact from the fall from Galahad Fortress. The Heart-to-Heart "Just Like Old Times", between Shulk and Fiora, can be found here. The External Sensor can be found here during Mysterious Noises.

Silver Lexos Hearts are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from Lexos inhabiting Valak Mountain. Silver Lexos Hearts are also available for trade. According to their description, they are beating hearts of shining silver that are likely to keep beating for one hundred years. Two Silver Lexos Hearts are needed for I Want to be a Homs!.

Slobos Ice Rocks are rare materials in . They can only be dropped by some of the Slobos on Valak Mountain. No one has them available for trade. According to their description, they are sub-zero rocks that can be used to make ice by submerging them in water. Two of them are needed to complete Betrothal Test involving En Argentis.

Silver Eks Plates are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by the Eks in Eryth Sea or traded for in Alcamoth and Eryth Sea. According to their description, they are reflective boards that amplify light and emit a highly powerful light. Two are needed for Starlight Seeker.

Slobos (Japanese: , Sorobosu) are an enemy family in and that can be found on Bionis, exclusively on Valak Mountain and the Bionis' Shoulder. They are large gorilla-walking species similar in appearance, and may be related to, Orlugas.
Sierra Vangs (Japanese: , Shiēra Vanpu) are enemies in . They are members of the Vang family, and can be found at level 42 on Valak Mountain in the Chilkin Lair and the Lava Cave.

Skyray Flesh are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Eques Skyrays in Prison Island or be traded for with Miriall and Vidian in Alcamoth. According to their description, they are flesh which are made up of red, yellow and blue sections of great flavour.

Six Stars (Japanese: , Mutsuraboshi, The Pleiades) is an Arms Manufacturer in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is the local branch of a Wrothian arms-dev group and is named after the six military strategists who formed the company. Its CEO is a Wrothian named De Zardo, who is not met in-game. The arms manufacturer opens after completing A Challenger Approaches affinity mission. Their weapons boast high damage, and work under the theory that user skill can make up for their inaccuracy. Their armor focuses on thermal resistance, and their weapons are either thermal or physical-attribute.

Skell Fuel is a Skell mechanic in , represented by a gauge. Skells need this fuel to function and consume it while flying, or by engaging in battle and using Skell Arts. The Skell Fuel gauge recovers slowly when Skells are inactive, including when the game is inactive, at the rate of approximately one unit of fuel every three seconds. Fuel costs are reduced to 0 during Overdrive and when Binding the enemy. Skells can regain fuel if they Bind an enemy during Overdrive. Skells can be refueled more quickly in New Los Angeles using Miranium, at the rate of 5,000 Miranium for 3,000 Fuel. This is a flat rate that cannot be manually adjusted. The Silent Mire (Japanese: , Seijaku no Numa) is an landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Primordia, north of West Janpath Plain, west of Tallpach Peak, and slightly northwest of FN Site 117. The Rock Cavern, an Unexplored Territory, can be found near this place. While peaceful during daylight hours, hostile Shadow Adseculas and Placid Duoguills will come out at night. An alien wreckage can be found on the island in the center, requiring Archaeology Level 2 skill to open.

Sibercaseras Mushrooms (Japanese: , Shibekaserasu-dake) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum and south-western Noctilum Waters. The probability of appearance is very rare. One Sibercaseras Mushroom is required for the Normal Mission The Party Line.

Sky Auravises (Japanese: , Sukai Akuira) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Auravis family, and can be found at level 45-46 at Primordia's Unicorn Rock. They can also be found at Headwater Summit. During the daytime they are aggressive and fly around, while at night they walk around and are non-agressive.
Smooth Tail Fins are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Purgovents by destroying their tailfin.

Skell Superweapons are fourteen special Skell Weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are extremely powerful weapons with high fuel costs. Each superweapon is available as level 30, 50 and 60 versions. They can be crafted at the AM Terminal after obtaining the schematics. The level 30 FILE-USPx40xx schematics are acquired after completing the game, the level 50 FILE-USPx60xx are obtained by opening certain Treasure Boxes, and the level 60 FILE-USPx80xx schematics are obtained as rewards for completing certain affinity or Normal Missions. Silver Cantor Teeth are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from silver variant Cantors, for 72 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks, or for 25 Material Tickets from the Material Market in . They are a component in X, XV, and XX Weapon Attack Power Up and Custom.WP-ATK augments.

Sicarius Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Meredith & Co. Sniper Rifle. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission Predator and Prey. The Sicarius weapons available in-game are: * Storm Sicarius * Soldier Sicarius * Warrior Sicarius * Ophidian Sicarius * Destroyer Sicarius * Striker Sicarius * Delta Sicarius * Cosmic Sicarius * Nebulan Sicarius

One Skill Branch is active at a time, and each branch has 5 skills, all of which require an increasing number of SP to unlock. SP are obtained from defeating enemies and discovering new locations. By prioritizing a Skill Branch and upon earning the required SP, its skills will automatically be unlocked, enabling special abilities or stats boosts. Slasher Buffon (Japanese: , Tsujigiri no Bafome) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Anlood family, and can be found at level 40 on an elevated plateau southeast of Mine No. 2 Entrance in the Empire of Mor Ardain. This plateau can be reached by riding moving containers that travel from Smùide Mountain to Geothermal Mining Plant. It appears anytime except during Sandstorm and Surface Heat weather. It must be defeated to unlock T-elos's level 3 "ECHIDNA".

Smùide Mountain (Japanese: , Shamaimu-san) is a location in . It is located in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. Access to this area is blocked until the Smùide Plant Key is obtained during the quest We Meet Again.

Snow Flower is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Tantal, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 2 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 50 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 12 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Botany", "Keen Eye" and "Icecraft" Field Skills.
Silas is an NPC in . He can be found near the Goldmouth Flight Deck in the Argentum Trade Guild.

The Snow-White Rhino is a Key Item in . It is found on a tiny island near Seigle Fell in the Gormott Province during A Young Man's Prize. Due to the geography of the area and quest limitations, it can only be collected in the early morning during high tide.

Smuggler Arrest is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Empire of Mor Ardain, and is unlocked automatically when the Garfont Mercenaries reach Merc Level 5 and the nation reaches 5 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 2 hours, but it can be reduced down to 30 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Info Collector", "Fortitude" and "Dark Mastery" Field Skills.

Sinking Storehouse? is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Leftherian Archipelago, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 5 stars in Development Level. It will only become available after visiting the Kingdom of Tantal for the first time. The time required to complete this mission is 2 hours, but it can be reduced down to 30 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Ice Mastery" and "Fire Mastery" Field Skills. It rewards store contracts that unlock the following wares: * Snowbaby Potato Salad in Corcaja Greengrocers

Smaghi is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian who stands by Eslan on the pathway to Garfont's Training Ground in the Kingdom of Uraya. He offers the Merc Mission Rogue Miners. Smaghi is an upbeat mercenary who comments on the growth of the Garfont mercenaries and how the other "classic" merc groups do not match their strength. He and his sister joined Garfont Mercenaries after receiving crucial help from Vandham.

Sky Moles (Japanese: , Amatsumogura) are collectables in . They can be found on the Bionis' Shoulder. According to their description, they are moles with wing-like appendages, and some say they have seen them fly. One is required for Riddle Faifa This.
Skirmishes (Japanese: , Seiryoku arasoi, lit. power struggle) are a mechanic in and .
Sikert Pathway (Japanese: , Sekureto Tsūro) is a Location in . It is located in the City.
Six Stars Warlord (Male) is a Holofigure in . It depicts a male mannequin wearing the complete Ga Jiarg's Bodywear series. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Affinity Mission Lionhearted.

Spike is a battle mechanic in and . It is an effect whereby the recipient is damaged or debuffed under certain conditions. Spike damage is shown as a purple-coloured number. Enemies' spike abilities have a limited radius, so the battle members can avoid the spike damage by being outside of the maximum radius. Enemies can also receive spike damage by battle members, who have a spike Aura active or spike gems equipped.

Sour Grapes (Japanese: , Shibudou) are collectables in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found on Valak Mountain. According to their description, an astringency results from chewing them and fermenting gives them a wonderful fragrance.

Sour Radishes (Japanese: , Sawā Daikon) are collectables in . They can be found on Valak Mountain. According to their description, their sour taste will give someone a kick and they are often used in alternative medicine.

Somati Kromars are minor enemies in . They are members of the Kromar family. They can be found at level 38 on Soltnar Seal Island at the Eryth Sea. Three of them must be defeated to complete Alcamoth's Monster Quest 4 - Part 1.

The Soothsayer's Crypt (Japanese: , Sōshu Nōkotsu-dō) is a location in . It is located in the Bafalgar Tomb, on the first floor of Tephra Cave and behind the hidden door that is only revealed after obtaining the Sacrificial Tablet needed for the quest The Path of Bafalgar. During the following quest The Coffin of Bafalgar, the Moonlight Book can be found during the night near the illuminated tomb.

Solare Nebulae (Japanese: , Sorāre Nebura) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Nebula family, and can be found at level 77 in the Corridor of Silence at Prison Island. They are the only source of Bolt Elements, which are needed for Colony 6 Reconstruction.

The Snow Radiant is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is one of the four radiants that must be collected for Imperial Ceremony Offerings and can only be obtained while this quest is active. It contains Ether. It is located within the Sealed Tower on Valak Mountain, inside Harict Chapel.

Snowi Taos (Japanese: , Sunōi Taōsu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Taos family, and can be found at level 47 on Valak Mountain. One of them can be found during the day north-northeast of La Luz Church. They are the only Taos that do not attack on sight.
Snowal Taos are enemies in . They are members of the Taos family, and can be found at level 48 on Valak Mountain. One of them can be found at night north-northeast of La Luz Church.

Spherical EM Motors (Japanese: , Kyūtai Denji Mōtā) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in the mountain regions of Noctilum. One may be acquired from completing My Dream. One is required for A Proper Chopper.
is a Skell frame fuel augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases Skell fuel capacity by 500 to 1500.

Spathi Glyphs are rare materials in . As a glyph, they are dropped by Unique Monsters between levels 60 and 69, plus level 57 Amorous Arca, level 58 Splendid Botis and level 59 Destroyer Salvacion. According to their description, the truth of space is inscribed on them and like every glyph, they sell for a high price on the market.

Snow Removal is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Tantal, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 1 star in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 30 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 7 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Fire Mastery" and "Ice Mastery" Field Skills.
Spicy Stralus are Meat Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Falala, Popstar at Rumbletum Canteen in the Argentum Trade Guild after the quest Fame and Family is completed.

Source Security is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Uraya, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 5 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 2 hours, but it can be reduced down to 30 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Expeditionist", "Electric Mastery" and "Water Mastery" Field Skills.

Snow Survey is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Tantal, and is unlocked automatically when the nation reaches 4 stars in Development Level. The time required to complete this mission is 100 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 25 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Keen Eye", "Ice Mastery" and "Mineralogy" Field Skills.

Sorinosori is a Nopon in . He is added in the version 1.5.2 update. He can be found at the Goldmouth Return Port in the Argentum Trade Guild after A Boy of Two Swords is collected and the ability to awaken Blades is unlocked. He is a courier who delivers the Divine Core Crystal to the party, after which he makes his leave.
Snowblast (Japanese: , Hisetsu, "Flying Snow") is one of Jin's Vanguard Arts in .

The Somnivore Lexos (Japanese: , Yumekui no Rekusosu) is a Quest Exclusive Enemy in . It is a member of the Lexos family, and can be found on the Bionis' Shoulder, at the back of the structure on Soltnar Seal Island. It must be defeated to initiate Brother's Keepsake, as it drops the Faded ID Tag belonging to Lavean's brother Sovean. The Somnivore Lexos is stated to have been Sovean's sworn enemy, and the ID tag implies that it killed Sovean. It does not respawn or drop items other than the Faded ID Tag despite not being marked as a Quest Enemy when attacked.
Sparks Fly, You Die is a Time Attack challenge in . It can be received from the Nopon Archsage. The challenge battle is located at Mechonis Field, it is unlocked after reaching Central Factory.

Soldato Feris are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Feris family, and can be found at level 44-46 on Thurbin Island in Erythia Sea.
Solshiss Camills are Minor Enemies in . They are members of the Camill family, and can be found at level 43-44 on Corne Island in Erythia Sea.

Sophora's Leaves are Key Items in . They can be found on Daedal Isle in Erythia Sea, and twenty must be collected during The Key to a New Home. The leaves are used to make wreaths for City citizens during their Homecoming.

Spider Web is a Battle Art in . It is an art of the Soulhacker class. It is acquired by defeating the Unique Monster Flyswatter Kamado while the Soul Hack skill is set on any player-controlled party member.

Song of Giga Rosa is a track from , composed by Kenji Hiramatsu. It is track fourteen of disc three on the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack, and track fourteen of disc eight on the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays during the following battles: * The first phase against Rosa. * Giga Rosa * True Rosa during the Challenge Battle Mk. VIII. * Don Dondon during Bana's Revenge. This song also plays when Poppibuster is revealed to the party during Shiny New Power.
Spine-Cannons are shoulder weapons for Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Qmoevas bosses or by destroying Qmoevas' weapon appendages.

Stardrops (Japanese: , Sutādoroppu) are collectables in and . They can be found in Alcamoth. According to their description, it looks like a purple star shining in the night sky and it inspires awe. Five are required for the Timed Quest Collection Quest 3 at Alcamoth.

Star Cutes (Japanese: , Sutā Kyūto) are collectables in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found on the Fallen Arm. According to their description, Fiora named them in a flurry and they are deep green stardust.

Stella Eks (Japanese: , Suterura Ekusu) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Eks family, and are found in the Eryth Sea at Anu Shore, on Hovering Reef 7, below Hovering Reef 5, below the Ether Crystal Deposit, at Hovering Reef 10 and at Khatorl Seal Island. Five Stella Eks must be defeated to complete Alcamoth's Monster Quest 2 - Part 2. They drop Silver Eks Plates, two of which are needed for Starlight Seeker. They are also the only enemy to drop Juicy Wild Meat, which is needed for Cook-Off Counter Attack!.
